title: •Ultimatum
caption: •Ultimatum (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Once per turn, during a battle at a Jabba’s Palace site, your destiny draws are each +1 and your Interrupts may not be canceled. May place this Effect out of play to cause a player to activate 2 Force.
lore: “Jabba! This is your last chance. Free us or die.”
